observations.footwork: Wide base established. Left foot planted, right rear foot pivots and heel lifts as the body rotates.
observations.guard: High and tight guard, hands held up near the chin.
observations.upper_body: Straight punch (right cross) extended forward with shoulder rotation.
observations.distance: Constant, throwing at an extended range.
observations.notable: First rear-hand cross thrown from a grounded, stable stance.

observations.footwork: Right foot shuffles or shifts, maintaining the wide stance while adjusting position.
observations.guard: High guard maintained throughout the movement.
observations.upper_body: Second right cross thrown with a similar side rotation.
observations.notable: Cross thrown in succession, showing a repeating drill pattern.

observations.footwork: Deep crouch and wide base, loading onto the back leg for power.
observations.guard: High guard beginning to drop slightly with the extended reach.
observations.upper_body: Third right cross, thrown with a deep body twist and forward lean.
observations.notable: Final cross of the set, with the lowest center of gravity and most powerful rotation.

movement_events.detail: Right cross extends forward with hip and shoulder rotation.
Right hand retracts back into the high guard.
Rear foot adjusts and slight shuffle as the next punch is prepared.
Another right cross is thrown, sinking lower into the stance for power.
